other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation Feature Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Group-based feature engineering (calculating means of numerical columns grouped by categorical columns) is performed on the entire training set prior to cross-validation splitting. This leaks feature distribution information from the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent implements a solid end-to-end pipeline with data cleaning, feature engineering, and cross-validation. However, the solution introduces critical target leakage by performing naive target encoding without out-of-fold smoothing, and leaks test and validation set distributions by applying frequency encoding and group aggregations before the respective splits.
